purpose: Supply the non-author documentary approval required by MATHSOLVE's unattributed-change protection for exact Release Trust CEI evidence pull requests, without mathematical adjudication, merge authority, or claim promotion.

validation_source.rule: The Clerk does not duplicate CEI profile or receipt validation; it imports the protected Programme validators.

approval_gate: branch is a registered CEI intake branch
protected dispatch and raw-plus-receipt evidence revalidate
ordinary PR exists from the exact intake branch to MATHSOLVE main
PR title matches the registered profile and dispatch
PR head SHA equals the live branch SHA
PR is open, non-draft, and not known unmergeable
no exact-head APPROVED review by gcl-council-clerk[bot] already exists
allowed_actions: read registered MATHSOLVE dispatch, evidence branch, PR, and review metadata
submit one APPROVE review as gcl-council-clerk[bot] bound to the exact validated PR head
retry idempotently after a head change only after full revalidation
prohibited_actions: open, close, or merge pull requests
promote claims, publication state, or competition state
downstream: MP-EXTERNAL-INTAKE-EVIDENCE-ADMISSION-001 requests the exact-head protected MATHSOLVE merge after this documentary approval and repository checks are satisfied.
